description: This is not a scientific figure. The supplied image is a publisher/Crossref-style "Check for updates" badge — a graphic icon, not a data panel. It consists of a rounded-rectangle tile with a white-to-light-grey background and a soft drop shadow, containing a single emblem centred above a two-line text label. The emblem is a circular ring broken into three coloured arc segments: a blue arc on the left-upper side, a yellow/gold arc on the lower side, and a small blue-teal segment on the right. Inside the ring sits a solid red "bookmark" / ribbon shape with a notched (V-cut) bottom edge. Below the emblem, the words "Check for updates" are set in two lines in a dark grey bold sans-serif typeface, "Check for" on the first line and "updates" on the second. There are no axes, no units, no gridlines, no scale bar, no legend, no sample labels, no curves and no plotted values anywhere in the image, so nothing about the medium-manganese low-density steel dataset can be read from it. No caption was extracted for this figure in the source text. It is almost certainly an incidental logo captured by the figure-extraction pipeline rather than an intended figure of the paper, and it carries zero materials-science information.
